walkthrough_kind: agent walkthrough using published instructions; not a human novice usability study

environment.dependencies: Python standard library only; existing Python 3.12 launcher

readme_command.script:
$runOut = Join-Path $env:TEMP ("ars-penguins-" + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString("N"))
py -3.12 -B -X utf8 examples/real-penguins/replay.py --output $runOut
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "复跑失败；请保留 $runOut 中的日志并交给助手排查。" }
Write-Host "报告：$(Join-Path $runOut 'REPORT.md')"

archived_verification.script:
$auditRun = Join-Path $env:TEMP ('ars-penguins-audit-' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N'))
Copy-Item -LiteralPath 'examples/real-penguins/recorded-run' -Destination $auditRun -Recurse
py -3.12 -B scripts/research_pipeline.py verify --run "$auditRun"
$structureExit = $LASTEXITCODE
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw '交接摘要核验未通过。' }
py -3.12 -B examples/real-penguins/verify_case.py --run "$auditRun"
$numericExit = $LASTEXITCODE
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw '数值核验未通过。' }
Write-Output "AUDIT_PATH=$auditRun"
Write-Output "STRUCTURE_EXIT=$structureExit"
Write-Output "NUMERIC_EXIT=$numericExit"

usability_findings.observed: Reusing an existing output directory is correctly rejected with exit 1 and leaves every file unchanged, but the displayed error is an English Python traceback.
usability_findings.impact: A novice can follow the documented fresh-directory command successfully; if manually reusing a path, the error presentation is more technical than the Chinese instructions.
usability_findings.handling: Recorded as an error-message usability limitation; no code or archived run was changed in this walkthrough.

usability_summary: The documented full PowerShell replay and Copy-Item archived-run verification both succeeded without a normal-path blocker. The README explains interim blocked transitions, output location, interpreter prerequisite and reused literature. One minor error-path presentation issue was observed: duplicate-output rejection displays a technical English traceback.
scope_limitations: The reviewer already knows the design and repository; this does not measure first-time human novice usability.
Only this Windows/Python environment and the fixed Penguins case were exercised; custom new research still requires host preparation.
The saved six-stage state was checked, and all six science artifacts were byte-identical; this is not peer review or a fresh literature search.
stdout_handling: Actual subprocess stdout/stderr preserved except explicit substitution of private local directory prefixes with <repository>, <new-replay>, <copied-recorded-run>. PowerShell UTF-8 output configuration and exit/path markers were added only to capture logs; documented commands were unchanged. JSON-escaped forms of the same private prefixes were normalized as well.
